local.backend: actual server.py, localhost:8088, no provider keys, workers disabled
local.frontend: actual Flutter release, localhost:8787, Emulator build flag

verification.rules: client create/update denied; delete only post owner; comments public only while parent exists
verification.transport_retry: same owner/content intent reuses request ID; changed content with same ID rejected
verification.async_lifecycle: duplicate send guarded; close/reload generations discard stale results

limits: No production community test message has been published to customers.
W25 verified trade/privacy/leaderboard remains a separate open gate.
Older clients that write posts directly to Firestore require the updated API client.
